# GuruLango

> > GuruLango is a free multilingual vocabulary learning platform using Spaced Repetition Algorithm to teach French, English, Korean, and Mandarin Chinese through interactive flashcards and games.

GuruLango offers 5000+ vocabulary words organized by practical topics like daily communication, work & career, culture & art, and shopping & service. The platform supports multiple learning paths with courses available in Korean, French, Vietnamese, and Chinese interfaces, making language learning accessible through scientifically-proven spaced repetition techniques.

## Key Topics

- Spaced Repetition Algorithm
- French vocabulary learning
- English vocabulary learning
- Korean language
- Mandarin Chinese
- Interactive flashcards
- Language topics (culture, work, daily life)
- Multilingual education
- Vocabulary games
- Cultural education
- Mobile language apps (Google Play, App Store)
- Beginner to advanced learning paths
- Topic-based vocabulary
- Free language learning

## Core Learning Platforms

- [Learn French Online Free - GuruLango](https://gurulango.com/learn-french): Free French learning app with 5000+ words using Spaced Repetition Algorithm
- [Learn French with GuruLango (Korean)](https://gurulango.com/ko/learn-french): French learning app for Korean speakers with flashcards & spaced repetition
- [Learn English Online Free - GuruLango](https://gurulango.com/zh/learn-english): English vocabulary app for Chinese speakers with games & spaced repetition

## English Vocabulary Topics

- [Daily Communication - English Vocabulary](https://gurulango.com/ko/learn-english/daily-communication): Beginner English phrases, greetings & basic communication for Korean learners
- [Work & Career - English Vocabulary](https://gurulango.com/ko/learn-english/work-career): English workplace vocabulary for Korean learners covering job titles & HR
- [Traffic & Transport - English Vocabulary](https://gurulango.com/vi/learn-english/traffic-transport): English transport vocabulary for Vietnamese learners using Spaced Repetition

## French Vocabulary Topics

- [Culture & Art - French Vocabulary](https://gurulango.com/fr/learn-french/culture-art): French vocabulary topic covering culture and art themes
- [Appearance - French Vocabulary](https://gurulango.com/fr/learn-french/appearance): French vocabulary for physical description, fashion & personal style
- [Traffic & Transport - French Vocabulary](https://gurulango.com/fr/learn-french/traffic-transport): French transport and traffic vocabulary with GuruLango
- [Food & Beverage - French Vocabulary](https://gurulango.com/vi/learn-french/food-beverage): French cuisine vocabulary for Vietnamese learners with Spaced Repetition

## Korean Vocabulary Topics

- [Culture & Art - Korean Vocabulary](https://gurulango.com/fr/learn-korean/culture-art): Korean culture, art & Kpop vocabulary topics for French learners
- [Shopping & Service - Korean Vocabulary](https://gurulango.com/ko/learn-korean/shopping-service): Korean shopping vocabulary covering payments & customer service
- [Daily Life - Korean Vocabulary](https://gurulango.com/fr/learn-korean/daily-life): Korean daily life vocabulary covering household & routine topics
- [Shopping & Service - Korean Vocabulary (Chinese)](https://gurulango.com/zh/learn-korean/shopping-service): Korean shopping vocabulary for Chinese learners covering online & offline
- [Health & Medicine - Korean Vocabulary](https://gurulango.com/vi/learn-korean/health-medicine): Korean medical vocabulary for Vietnamese learners covering symptoms & body

## Mandarin Chinese Vocabulary Topics

- [Family & Friends - Mandarin Chinese](https://gurulango.com/ko/learn-chinese/family-friends): Mandarin Chinese social vocabulary covering relationships & celebrations
